verdict.rationale: Lambda's pricing page offers reserved capacity at its lowest prices, and the docs describe reserving 1-Click Clusters, so a discounted sustained-capacity option exists. However, it is sales-led ("contact us"), and no commitment terms, discount levels or self-serve purchase flow are documented. Missing for 10: documented reservation term lengths and discount rates, self-serve committed-use purchasing, independent corroboration of reserved pricing.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity

citations.quote: Contact us for reserved capacity at our lowest prices.
Navigate to the 1-Click Clusters page in the Lambda Cloud console and click Reserve 1-Click Cluster.
Private Cloud is the ideal solution for organizations requiring a single-tenant cluster with 1,000+ GPUs.
